description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEmergencyContactsController class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages the display and permissions setup for an employee's emergency contacts view, including pre-render processing based on employee number from the request.

classes.name: EmployeeEmergencyContactsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the employee emergency contacts view, including permission checks and preparing Vue components based on employee data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering with employee emergency contact data and permissions, based on the employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability/permission verification related to emergency contacts.
